title: MatchCompleted
description: A closed match, published by the match service for stats and tournament. One per match: matchId is the key for idempotency.

eventId.description: Id of the outbox row: for logs and tracing, not for idempotency

tenantId.description: Organization of the venue, as declared by the hub

tournamentMatchId.description: Missing for friendly or offline matches

winnerSide.description: Missing if the match was cancelled or ended in a draw

participantId.description: Squad or player: missing if the match was played without login

points.description: The points that counted, in order: the goals in foosball. It can be shorter than the final score if the hub did not deliver every event, and a point that arrives after the match was closed is not added: the score in sides is the one that counts
